title: Brunch Table Continuity
description: Four reference-linked brunch heroes establishing a bright, layered weekend tabletop language.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the tableware family, daylight behavior, linen palette, and social brunch rhythm. Images 02-04 preserve that tabletop system while rotating hero dishes and service emphasis.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-weekend-table-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for the remaining series images. Queue may run the dependent variations concurrently after the reference is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
